## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Describe the checks performed and their results, including any limitations.

## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] All commits have a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off.
- [ ] The contribution follows CONTRIBUTING.md and the applicable licenses.
- [ ] Copyright, attribution, and third-party notices are preserved or updated.
- [ ] Relevant documentation, examples, and evaluation cases are updated.
- [ ] The proposed skill has been validated and shown to improve LLM performance or efficiency.

## Maintainer Checklist

- [ ] For skill changes, a maintainer or admin posted `/nvskills-ci` after the latest skill/evaluation changes and validation succeeded (see README.md#nvskills-validation).
- [ ] Required IP review is complete for all contributed material before public distribution.
- [ ] Licensing and third-party use are covered by the project's approvals.
- [ ] For catalog publication, validation passed and generated benchmark, card, and signatures match the final skill content.
